Subway 02

Step-free guide

Platforms1–4

Elevatorエレベーター7 lifts, not 1

This station has seven separate lifts, numbered EV.1 to EV.7 — not one lift for the whole station. Which one you need depends on your line and direction, so the city publishes the route lift by lift and tells you which train door to board from.

EV.3Higashiyama platform → North Gate
Nearest doors: 2 towards Takabata, 18 towards Fujigaoka.
EV.6Higashiyama platform → Central Gate
Nearest doors: 17 towards Takabata, 18 towards Fujigaoka. Also used continuing on to Sakura-dori.
EV.1Sakura-dori platform → West Gate
First leg of the Sakura-dori step-free route.
EV.2West Gate → JR concourse
Second leg, continuing up from EV.1.Nearest doors for this route: 9 towards Taikodori, 20 towards Tokushige.
EV.5Sakura-dori Central Gate → platform
Used when transferring in from Higashiyama.
EV.7Sakura-dori Central Gate → East Gate
Used when transferring in from Higashiyama, after EV.6.

Accessible toilet車椅子トイレ3 areas, outside the gates

There are three toilet areas outside the gates, plus one inside that is not step-free: the one inside the Sakura-dori East gate has no barrier-free cubicle, and steps at both entrances. The city’s own text access guide describes the other three area by area.

ABy the Sakura-dori West-Central gate
Outside the gates, accessible.
BBy the Higashiyama North gate or Central-North gate
Two accessible toilets side by side in one shared spot — reached from either the North gate or the north side of the Central gate, not two separate locations.
CThe second toilet, same spot as B
Right beside B, at the same signboard — one is signed to the left, one to the right.
DBy the Higashiyama South gate
Outside the gates, accessible.
Not accessible
Inside the Sakura-dori East gate — no barrier-free cubicle, steps at both entrances.
What this means
If you need a barrier-free toilet, plan to pass back through the barrier for it.
Finding them
A voice announcement plays as you approach each one.

Entrances & exits出入口All by stairs

Every numbered street exit, 1 to 13, is reached by stairs. There are three step-free ways up to the street.

Step-free 1
The JR Gate Tower B1 lift, from the North or Central-North gate. Comes out on the north pavement of the station rotary.
Step-free 2
EV.4 from the Central Gate, to the west side of the Nagoya Station crossing.
Step-free 3
From the Sakura-dori West Gate, a lift up to the JR concourse.
Exit 9
Bus terminal, JR Gate Tower, the JR Sakuradori gate, the Shinkansen and Kintetsu — but by stairs.
Exit 12
Meitetsu North Gate.
Exit 13
The Taikodori side.
Building lifts
JP Tower Nagoya, JR Gate Tower, Dai Nagoya Building, Midland Square, and Nagoya Lucent Tower (limited hours).

Platforms & doorsのりば1 to 4

Two lines, four platforms. Higashiyama has a North, Central and South gate; Sakura-dori has a West, West-Central and East gate.

Higashiyama Line
1 for Sakae and Fujigaoka. 2 for Nakamura-koen and Takabata.
Sakura-dori Line
3 for Imaike and Tokushige. 4 for Taikodori.
Door numbers
Marked on the platform floor — that is what the lift routes above refer to.

Help & information案内052-522-0111

Service centre, coin lockers, ATM and a wheelchair-accessible toilet at the station.

Telephone centre
052-522-0111, 8:00–19:00.

Source · Nagoya City Transportation Bureau: station information, barrier-free routes, and the text access guide for screen readers (kotsu.city.nagoya.jp/rp/reader/trp0004209.htm, gates & exits; trp0004211.htm, toilets); Nagoya Station Map (meieki.com), B1F sheet. Re-verified September 2026.
